preparation.scope: Analytic correctness fixture, not a claimed photographic reconstruction improvement.
constraints: Retain the mask and both missing/observed accounting.
Exclude padding from paper-color estimation as well as downstream fitting.
Preserve coverage through import, editor actions, undo, save/restore and solver handoff.
Explicitly painted pixels become known, including same-color edits.
Transparent pixels inside the source retain the selected background-compositing semantics.

classification.fixture: Opaque grayscale papers at RGB 100 and 120; identical photographed pixels, with and without white outside-image padding.
classification.conclusion: Missing pixels affect automatic paper classification before any loss weights can be applied. Ignoring padding in fitting alone cannot recover the already collapsed paper labels.

handoff.finding: rectify composites out-of-bounds samples with the selected background. preprocessPixels quantizes the whole result without coverage. preprocessBinaryMask does not accept validMask.
prepare preview exports optional importance weights but no observation validity. Existing source-image error accounting already distinguishes validMask when it is present.
maskFromPrepared returns only size/data; any added engine observation field would still be dropped here.
Mask currently stores size/data only. Cloning and packed persistence need observation support.
maskToArtwork copies the mask and optionally free-border importance, without photo observation coverage.
Same-colour painting returns early. When unknown cells are introduced, explicit painting of that same colour must still mark those cells known.
Lift/transform/commit copies only colour cells. Observation must follow the patch, and explicitly cleared cells must become known.
Persistence stores only packed colour cells; unknown regions would be lost after restore without schema support.

requirements: Keep missing photographic evidence separate from permission to alter a free border.
Exclude outside-source padding from palette estimation before forming the colour mask.
Keep original RGB/crop and report observed/missing area so changed scoring is inspectable. Do not compare a newly masked metric directly to old whole-crop percentages.
Propagate observation through worker preparation, import, mask edits, symmetry, selection, undo/redo, persistence, solve and result comparison.
An ordinary image or drawing without missing observations keeps its existing meaning.
Keep alpha compositing for transparent artwork independent from missing source coordinates.
Reject an entirely unobserved input explicitly; it must not score zero disagreement.
Test missing-pixel colour invariance in count initialization, fitting, feature checks, matching preference and final export.
Re-run original frozen corpus outputs separately from any new coverage-aware benchmark.
limitations: Analytic fixtures demonstrate bugs, not improvement on the three clipped photographs. No production source, crop, mask, threshold or benchmark denominator changed by this diagnosis.
